en: Old sepia-toned street view of a quiet town with cobblestone paving and wooden one- to two‑storey buildings lining both sides. Utility poles run along the street, and a low, long wooden building with a mansard-like curved gable stands prominently on the right corner. A few people are visible in the distance. The architecture is northern European and early 20th century in style. Some small shop signs are visible in the windows of the corner building, but they are difficult to read.
